title: Root-power quotients of nil-Hecke algebras and Weyl invariant theory
summary: We study nil-Hecke quotients defined by powers of root coordinates. We identify their central ideals through the determinant components of root-orbit power ideals. Apolarity and discriminant removal reduce the graded dual centers to directional bounds on invariant polynomials. We determine their Hilbert series for every exponent and root orbit in all irreducible crystallographic types except $E_6,E_7,E_8$.
